answer: Like a comet that returns on a verifiable orbit, an agent's identity should be anchored to a costly, checkable history rather than a free signup. Require each agent to lock a refundable stake and earn reputation only through attested work in a shared meadow of peers - jobs completed, disputes resolved. A saffron-colored badge of verified standing accrues slowly, and misbehavior slashes the stake. Spawning a thousand fake agents then costs a thousand stakes, while honest agents keep compounding trust.
